stage: P2 policy registry only; not a runtime validator or a claim of implemented protobuf transport

contract.domainSource: Fixed configured authority; never derive from Host, forwarded headers, GID or TL IDs. Tests use an independently configured isolated domain and isolated data, not production.
contract.identity: Reuse existing user/group UUIDs and stable TelegramIds mappings; never regenerate identities or substitute GID for UUID.
contract.self: UserSelector.self and PeerRef.self must be true when selected; false is 400, never fall through to another identity.
contract.presence: Rebuild TL flags from actual scalar/message/oneof presence and supported booleans; never forward raw TL flags. Unknown required semantics must fail rather than silently disappear.
contract.time: Wire timestamps are Unix milliseconds. TL seconds -> milliseconds uses checked multiplication by 1000; wire milliseconds -> TL seconds uses floor division by 1000 then checked int32 conversion, never unchecked casts. Reject overflow with 400.
contract.messageIds: Every message_id, message_ids element, offset/min/max/reply/read/message-ID mapping converted to Android TL int32 uses checked conversion; overflow is 400, never truncate. Keep sfixed64 random_id/client_id exact, not JS floating point.
contract.http: Preserve HTTP statuses for authentication, permissions, validation, conflict, rate limit and unsupported features; RpcError.http_status matches HTTP, never wrap an error as 200. Preserve existing 128 KiB request-body boundary (131072 bytes, including chunked/streamed bodies); over limit is 413 before business dispatch. No limits are relaxed by protobuf.
contract.unknownSubclass: Reject unsupported concrete TL subclasses with 501 even when their fields have default values. Missing required peer/user/reply/entity target is 400. InputPeerEmpty is allowed only as an absent getDialogs offset_peer, not as a business peer.
contract.defaultDefinition: Primitive false/0, null or empty string, null or empty collection, and absent message are default. A present optional feature/message is non-default even if its payload scalars are zero; flags are rebuilt separately.
contract.validation: Retain existing membership, participant, request size, paging, entity UTF-16 bounds/count/URL, idempotency, GID and persistence validation. Registration here does not implement those validators.

local.reason: Android-only transport metadata; networkType/disableFree never leave client.

flags.reason: Rebuild from supported field presence and booleans, not the integer flags.

selfSender.when: absent or resolves to authenticated self
selfSender.reason: Validate explicit sender through supported InputPeer resolution, then omit redundant authenticated-self identity; never allow impersonation.

sameReplyPeer.when: absent or resolves to the send target conversation
sameReplyPeer.reason: Validate the reply peer matches the enclosing send target before omitting redundant peer; preserve same-conversation replies only.

searchLimit.reason: Preserve legacy exact-contact search: limit is not used; result is the authorized exact-match set, not an unbounded general search.

pinnedFolder.reason: Preserve legacy pinned query: all folders return an empty pinned set; this does not implement folder-specific pinning.

excludePinned.reason: v1 has no pinned dialogs and pinned queries return an empty set; excluding pinned dialogs therefore preserves the result. Revisit when pinning is implemented.

localDraft.reason: Drafts are local-only in v1; Android SendMessagesHelper clears the local draft on send. No server draft exists to clear; this does not claim cloud draft synchronization.

cacheHash.reason: No not-modified cache response in v1; always return authorized current data.

syncDate.reason: SyncService uses per-user pts, not wall-clock date; response time remains authoritative.

qts.reason: No encrypted-message stream; qts is not a supported cursor, response qts remains zero.

reject.reason: Unsupported business intent must not be silently lost, including features the legacy Gateway ignored.

accessHash.reason: MTProto access_hash is not authorization; Bearer, UUID mapping and membership authorize local references.

map.reason: Map through the named typed protobuf field; retain existing business validation.

noWebpage.reason: v1 generates no link previews; the flag has no observable behavior difference in sending, editing or drafts.

uploadProgress.reason: Typing action kind is relayed without upload progress percentages.

offset_date.reason: Legacy dialog pagination uses offset_id and offset_peer, not date; intentionally not a wire field.

offset_peer.reason: Empty offset means absent peer only here.

transportOperations.purpose: Authenticated transport-only bootstrap; not an Android TL class or an additional TL operation.
transportOperations.validation: At most 100 combined IDs; each list contains unique positive int64 IDs. Unknown users/groups and nonmember groups return 404. Every response includes authenticated self exactly once and configured canonical server_domain, including an empty request. Missing persisted self mapping returns 404 SELF_IDENTITY_NOT_FOUND without allocating it.
transportOperations.identity: Reverse existing TelegramIds user:<uuid>/chat:<uuid> keys only; no allocation or traversal that allocates IDs. Groups require Owned membership. Existing UUIDs, summaries, TelegramIds and NextTelegramId remain stable.

featureOperations.purpose: Full authoritative account-private snapshot for periodic and reconnect refresh; no EventHint or pts changes.
featureOperations.validation: Authenticated owner only. UUID identities and monotonic account revision persist in privacy state.

featureOperations.purpose: Return the complete authoritative snapshot after durable mutation.
featureOperations.validation: Enable requires a real nonself contact and neither party blocking. Disable is idempotent for known users; unknown targets return 404. Only real changes increment revision. Delete/reset/block clear preferences without restoration.

featureOperations.purpose: Account-private NoFile catalogue and durable revision query; reconnect/login/foreground recovery must query even when EventHint was lost.
featureOperations.validation: Optional hash is an account revision, not pts. A hash hit still returns installed state and revision; missing state is unknown, explicit cleared is authoritative.

featureOperations.purpose: Persist or remove a private saved NoFile colour/gradient; signed id plus all settings is the key, including id zero.
featureOperations.validation: Only typed NoFile accepted; explicit colour presence and settings validation. Idempotent exact replay, no payment or upload side effect. At most 100 saved items, overflow is 409 WALLPAPER_SAVED_LIMIT.

featureOperations.purpose: Persist the authenticated account's global default without inventing a chat service message or pts.
featureOperations.validation: Explicit wallpaper or clear oneof required; success only after durable commit. NoFile validation shared with save and chat set.

featureOperations.purpose: Persist personal overrides or a two-person direct conversation shared wallpaper. New update kind is returned only to this caller, never to legacy pts/difference streams.
featureOperations.validation: Membership checked. Groups/saved allow personal view only. for_both requires direct and removes both overrides; revert requires no selection and for_both false. clear explicitly suppresses shared wallpaper. Service-message adoption is 501; no synthetic service message, message sequence or pts.

featureOperations.purpose: Authenticated account privacy and security operations.
featureOperations.validation: Reuse AccountPrivacyService validation, local user references, ownership and persistence checks.

featureOperations.purpose: Add an existing local user to the authenticated account contacts and return the target user with contact flags.
featureOperations.validation: Reject self, unknown users, unsupported notes and privacy-exception options, and names longer than 64 characters. Retry upserts the same owner/user pair.

g_a_hash.conversion: 32-byte SHA-256 of the caller key; any other length is 400 CALL_INVALID_GA_HASH

g_b.conversion: Exactly 256 bytes; replay of the same accepted g_b is idempotent, any other value is 409 CALL_ALREADY_ACCEPTED

g_a.conversion: Exactly 256 bytes and SHA-256(g_a) must equal the requestCall g_a_hash; mismatch is 400 CALL_HASH_MISMATCH

key_fingerprint.conversion: Checked int64; non-zero required. Same value replay is idempotent, conflict is 409 CALL_ALREADY_ACTIVE

data.conversion: At most 4096 bytes and only while the call is active; otherwise 400

debug.conversion: TL bytes to the diagnostic text field; at most 16384 bytes

version.conversion: Checked int32; 0 requests the full configuration

user_id.conversion: Stable TL user ID -> existing UUID and configured local domain

chat_id.conversion: Stable TL chat ID -> existing group UUID

TL_inputPeerEmpty.only: getDialogs.offset_peer: default -> absent; all other contexts 400

user_id.conversion: Stable TL ID to existing UUID and configured authority

reply_to_msg_id.conversion: Same-conversation message only; checked TL int32

flags.reason: Preserve legacy contact-note capability guard: any nonzero flags is unsupported; unlike ordinary structural flags this must not be silently discarded.

offset.conversion: UTF-16 code units, bounds checked against text; no UTF-8 byte offsets

authOperations.purpose: Unauthenticated protocol negotiation: protocols, event subprotocols, capabilities and the permanent JSON-retirement status.
authOperations.validation: No token required on /api/v1/auth. Never reveals account data or enables any retired JSON interface.

authOperations.purpose: Create an account and return a bearer session plus the typed account profile.
authOperations.validation: Unauthenticated /api/v1/auth, rate limited, password hashed with salted PBKDF2, GID allocated server-side; no plaintext password persisted or logged.

authOperations.purpose: Authenticate an existing account and issue a bearer session.
authOperations.validation: Unauthenticated /api/v1/auth, rate limited, constant-time verifier comparison; failures do not disclose account existence.

authOperations.purpose: Return password verification parameters and optional password update material.
authOperations.validation: Pre-auth only for verification parameters; password changes require the current password and are rate limited. Never returns a stored hash.

authOperations.purpose: Recover an account with a one-time recovery code and issue a session.
authOperations.validation: Unauthenticated /api/v1/auth, rate limited; a used recovery code is consumed in the same transaction.
Requires a valid Bearer on /api/v1/rpc; only the current token hash is removed.
Authenticated owner only; returns the public profile, never salt/password hash or private keys.

authOperations.purpose: Read or locally activate Nyarugram Premium.
authOperations.validation: Authenticated owner only; no Telegram payment path, activation persists on the account.

authOperations.purpose: Change the account Gram ID with server-side allocation and collision checks.
authOperations.validation: Authenticated owner only; rejects World/country/unknown regions, non-eight-digit or all-zero suffixes; UUID and TL identity stay stable.

authOperations.purpose: Read, set up, confirm or disable the authenticator and recovery codes.
authOperations.validation: Authenticated owner only; secrets are encrypted in the account privacy state, recovery codes are versioned HMAC values and plaintext is returned once.

e2eeOperations.purpose: Publish the device identity, signed/kyber pre-keys and one-time pre-key batch; a changed identity key bumps the generation and suspends active encrypted chats.
e2eeOperations.validation: Authenticated owner only, device_id=1, bounded key/signature lengths and unique pre-key ids. Replacing an identity invalidates old pre-key material and versioned identity confirmations in one transaction.

e2eeOperations.purpose: Directional encrypted-chat state machine: invite, accept, decline, cancel, close and reactivation after an identity change.
e2eeOperations.validation: Direct two-member conversation, protocol_version=2, per-chat advisory lock. E2EE_CONFIRM_IDENTITY requires the exact peer key, generation, epoch and two-sided identity version the user saw; any mismatch or missing snapshot fails without state, confirmation, epoch or service-message side effects.

e2eeOperations.purpose: Read the encrypted-chat status for selected peers, including the current two-sided identity_version echoed by confirmation requests.
e2eeOperations.validation: Authenticated member only; each peer must be a direct-conversation participant. Never exposes plaintext or private keys.

e2eeOperations.purpose: List all encrypted direct chats for the authenticated account.
e2eeOperations.validation: Authenticated owner only; pending chats are included only when requested. Never exposes plaintext or private keys.

e2eeOperations.purpose: Fetch the peer device bundle and atomically consume one one-time pre-key for session establishment.
e2eeOperations.validation: Authenticated member of a direct conversation with a published peer device; missing pre-keys fail with E2EE_PREKEYS_EXHAUSTED. Consumption is never replayed twice.
